meta.homeTitle: Qingyu Timetable - Course info, system experience
meta.homeDescription: Qingyu Timetable is an Android & HyperOS course app with Dynamic Island, couple schedules, academic import, WebDAV sync, home widgets, and staged reminders. Free, open source, no ads.
meta.schoolsDescription: Browse universities with academic portal import and generic adapters. Continuously updated.

brand.name: Qingyu Timetable
hero.eyebrow: Built for Android & HyperOS · Free & open source
hero.subtitle: See the next class on Dynamic Island, the whole week on home widgets, and free slots with your partner. One-tap academic import, staged reminders, WebDAV sync—your timetable finally lives in the system.
features.label: Features
features.title: More than a timetable—
features.desc: From Dynamic Island to home widgets, from two people's schedules to a full semester report—every feature exists so you check your phone less and understand today more.
feature.island.title: Dynamic Island watches your next class
feature.island.desc: Pre-class warm-up, in-class status, and after-class handoff flow on the island. Quick actions like mute and DND restore automatically after class.
feature.couple.title: Couple schedule
feature.couple.desc: Share your schedule, bind, and overlay on the home screen: mine, theirs, together, and free time—four colors at a glance. No more screenshot chats for dinner plans.
feature.import.title: One-tap academic portal import
feature.import.desc: 100+ universities support web login sync. Others can use .ics, AI image import, or spreadsheet templates.
feature.webdav.title: WebDAV cloud sync
feature.webdav.desc: Sync schedules and settings across phone and tablet with Nutstore or self-hosted WebDAV. Browse history, restore, or delete backups.
feature.bill.title: Semester report
feature.bill.desc: Overview, badges, data stories, daily hour charts, course rankings—share a long image when the term ends.
feature.system.title: Widgets + staged reminders
feature.system.desc: Home widgets keep the full week visible. Reminders advance before, during, and near the end of class—not a single isolated alert.
feature.lan.title: Edit on your computer
feature.lan.desc: Start a LAN service on your phone, edit in a desktop browser, and sync back instantly. Bulk edits without poking a tiny screen.
feature.open.title: Free, ad-free, auditable
feature.open.desc: GPL-3.0 open source, no ads, no sign-up, data stored locally. Transparent code—issues and PRs welcome on GitHub.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Things you might ask
faq.q1: How do I import a timetable?
faq.a1Html:
Three ways:

  1. Academic portal: Menu → Import timetable → pick your school → sign in to sync
  2. File import: iCal (.ics)—choose a file on your phone
  3. Manual: Tap an empty slot → Add course → fill in details
faq.a2Html: 100+ universities are supported. See the full list on the supported schools page. If yours is missing, use .ics, AI image import, or manual entry—or request support on qingyu_warehouse.
faq.a3Html: Yes—completely free, no ads, no registration. Open source and transparent.
faq.a4Html: Android only for now, with deep HyperOS (Xiaomi/Redmi) support. No iOS or HarmonyOS plans yet.
faq.q5: Why doesn't Dynamic Island work on my phone?
faq.a5Html: Dynamic Island needs Xiaomi HyperOS 3.0.300 or newer. Check Settings → About phone; upgrade if you're below 3.0.300.
faq.q6: Can my timetable data be lost?
faq.a6Html: Data is stored locally, with WebDAV sync and full backup/restore. Back up regularly; migrate via cloud or backup files when switching devices.
faq.q7: How do I set odd/even weeks?
faq.a7Html: When adding or editing a course, choose Odd or Even under Repeat. Custom week ranges are also supported.

privacy.intro: Qingyu Timetable respects your privacy. Schedules, time templates, import history, and reminder settings stay on device. Network access happens only when you use online features.
privacy.l1a: Courses, weeks, time templates, multi-schedule settings
privacy.l1b: Academic/.ics import results and backup/restore data
privacy.l1c: Reminder settings, widget state, some app logs
privacy.l2a: Check for updates and download packages
privacy.l2b: Read GitHub Releases, site version info, and mirror routes
privacy.l2c: Academic web login import and warehouse adapter info
privacy.l2d: Analytics/diagnostics SDKs only after you opt in
privacy.p3: Logs stay local for troubleshooting. Files leave the device only if you export and share them.
privacy.p4: Updates, site display, GitHub Releases, and optional analytics may use GitHub, mirrors, or Umeng. All require user action or consent.
privacy.p5: Questions about data, logs, or networking? Reach maintainers via GitHub Issues or in-app feedback.
terms.intro: Qingyu Timetable provides schedule management, import, reminders, widgets, and updates for Android. By installing and using it, you agree to these rules.
terms.l1a: Intended for personal study and schedule management
terms.l1b: You must ensure imported schedules and calendar data are lawfully obtained
terms.l1c: Do not use the app or adapters for abusive, bulk, or unauthorized scraping
terms.l2b: Confirm OS version, architecture, and source trust before install
terms.l2c: Prereleases may be less stable than stable builds
terms.p3: Reminders, Dynamic Island, notifications, and widgets depend on OS version, OEM policy, permissions, and battery rules—behavior may vary by device.
terms.p4: The project is open source. Code, releases, and packages are distributed via GitHub and this site. You may inspect source, report issues, and contribute under the license.
terms.p5: Report bugs, compatibility issues, or school import requests via GitHub Issues or in-app feedback.
